mapper.select: SELECT scheduled_id, scheduled_name, scheduled_type, cron_expression, target_system, target_interface, status, last_run_time, next_run_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM finance_scheduled WHERE scheduled_id = #{scheduledId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO finance_scheduled ( scheduled_id, scheduled_name, scheduled_type, cron_expression, target_system, target_interface, status, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{scheduled.scheduledId}, #{scheduled.scheduledName}, #{scheduled.scheduledType}, #{scheduled.cronExpression}, #{scheduled.targetSystem}, #{scheduled.targetInterface}, #{scheduled.status}, #{scheduled.createBy}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE finance_scheduled SET scheduled_name = #{scheduled.scheduledName}, scheduled_type = #{scheduled.scheduledType}, cron_expression = #{scheduled.cronExpression}, target_system = #{scheduled.targetSystem}, target_interface = #{scheduled.targetInterface}, status = #{scheduled.status}, update_by = #{scheduled.updateBy}, update_time = SYSDATE WHERE scheduled_id = #{scheduled.scheduledId}
